name: led_strip
title: led_strip
notes: Described from its headers and documentation, not tried.

init.notes: led_strip_config_t names the data GPIO, the number of LEDs, LED_MODEL_WS2812 and the order of the colors (GRB when none); one RMT channel a strip.
Takes a whole SPI host and starts its bus itself, with MOSI only: the program does not start that bus.

ws2812b.notes: The data is sent by the RMT or by an SPI host at 2.5 MHz; a chip with no RMT, as the ESP32-C2, has the SPI way only. Without DMA the RMT way takes many interrupts, and a late one, as of Wi-Fi, spoils a frame.

api.source: led_strip/include and docs of espressif/idf-extra-components at 8e30fe6f, the code of the registry's 3.1.1 (uploaded from 65ccbe19)
